messages:
aisha-k: Hey people-ops — new engineering manager (EM) starts Monday. Can someone drop a compact, DM-ready first-week grid + must-have access list? Want things I can hand off to them over Slack.
sally-hr: Congrats! Happy to compile. Quick Q: do you want manager-specific compliance + people-lead essentials (1:1 templates / calibration) included or just ops/access?
aisha-k: Include both please — we need concise: day-by-day agenda, who-to-ask for access, hardware pickup, security & payroll steps, and an intro script to team.
benjamin: Pinging with a short microagenda I use for new leads. Copy/paste friendly.
benjamin: ```First-week microgrid (manager starter)
Day 0 (pre-start):
 - Send intro email to team + 1:1 spreadsheet (template below)
 - Confirm laptop + dongles delivery with IT (ticket)
Day 1:
 - Quick welcome + org orientation (30m)
 - 1:1 with manager's skip-level partner (30m)
 - HR kick-off (payroll/benefits/security) (45m)
 - Set calendar blocks for recurring 1:1s with direct reports (15m)
Day 2:
 - Tech access: GitHub org, CI, Redwood Console read access (or dedicated access request)
 - Shadow onboarding: attend a product demo with a PM (60m)
Day 3:
 - Ops & infra intro (30m) — who to ping for capacity/quotas
 - Team retro / expectations sync (45m)
Day 4:
 - Setup performance & goal doc (start 30/60/90 draft)
 - Meet with Eng Manager peer group (1h)
Day 5:
 - One-week check-in with People Ops & manager (30m)
 - Ship first-week priorities to their manager

Who-to-ask mapping (short):
 - IT/hardware: @claire-m (it-ops)
 - Accounts & access (SaaS): @dev-onboard-bot / infra-requests channel
 - Payroll/benefits: @sally-hr
 - Security & compliance: security-oncall
 - Dedicated infra quotas / GPU: eng-infra

Quick access request snippets (paste into infra-requests):
 - "Please grant GitHub org read/write to: <email>, team: <team-name>"
 - "Grant Redwood Console: viewer role for <email> (region: us-west-2)"
 - "Create AWS IAM console role: ManagerAssume-<name> (duration: 8h/day)"

One-line intro script to share to the team (DM or #team):
 - "Hi all — I’m [Name], your new Engineering Lead. Excited to meet folks. I’ll be scheduling 1:1s over the next week; ping me if you have immediate items."

1:1 starter template (30m):
 - Quick intro + background (5m)
 - What keeps you excited/frustrated (10m)
 - Immediate priorities & support needed (10m)
 - Follow-ups & flags (5m)

Manager 30/60/90 (short phrasing):
 - 30: Learn + assess; meet direct reports; unblock immediate stuff.
 - 60: Drive small improvements; set measurable team goals.
 - 90: Own roadmap items; hiring / capacity plan sketched.

Notes: keep all access requests in the infra-requests channel so audit trail exists. Use DD/MM as date format if you're coordinating with EMEA teams.``` 
claire-m: Added a couple infra specifics: laptop pickup is at IT Ops on 3rd floor — bring ID. For GPU or Dedicated requests, add the project code and expected qps.
dev-onboard-bot: Automated checklist created: https://redwood.internal/onboard/checks/2105-EM-quickgrid (contains ticket templates and links). :robot_face:
aisha-k: This is perfect — can I get a one-paragraph HR-ready blurb to DM new lead? Want something succinct for day0 messaging.
sally-hr: Sure — "Welcome to Redwood! On your first day you'll meet with HR for payroll & benefits, receive security training, and confirm equipment. Please complete the profile in People Portal and accept the calendar invites for 1:1s with your team." Feel free to shorten.
benjamin: One quick tips list for managers (tiny bullets to DM):
 - Block 2 hours/day for first week to meet people.
 - Prioritize trust-building over process on day 1.
 - Ask for past 3 sprint retros; skim them.
 - Keep access requests in infra-requests with project code.

claire-m: @aisha-k — I've opened IT ticket #IT-4729 for laptop assignment, ETA Mon morning. Please share name and preferred shipping address if remote.
aisha-k: Thx team. Sharing with new lead now. Appreciated! :raised_hands:
